head: feat/grave-accord-production
title: Author Grave Accord's 60-boss production design and proof packet
body:
Expands the authored design to 60 distinct bosses: 50 in separate timed-route pools, nine Endless exclusives and The Uncounted. Adds numerical mechanics/counterplay, 15 complete translation catalogs, cleaner finish references, original audio, canonical Wiki guides and a source verification workflow.

Validation: 16,716 analytical boss/build cases, 2,255 legal mutation sets, 4,000 seeded timed gauntlets, 40,000 Endless encounters, 14 localization negative checks and 150 plural samples pass. The 72-page illustrated PDF and 208-member packet were rendered/reviewed and verified across source, fresh extraction and normal Windows copy. Hashes are recorded in reviews/stage1-delivery-review.json.

This is preproduction content and evidence. Gameplay, live networking/performance, the complete production asset library, physical-device checks and human/native-speaker review remain subsequent gates.
